title: ci: run e2e job on bigger environment
body: This PR uses a larger docker environment to run the e2e tests job. While it still takes a while to run (which could be attributed in part to our saucelabs opensource plan), the tests seem to run more reliably (no retries) and the CPU usage doesn't hit 100%.
